title: What no other nursery app in MENA has

items.title: One-tap check-in
items.body: Parents check in within 100 metres. No PIN, QR code, or tablet at the door.

items.title: Know who read it
items.body: See which parents opened a closure notice or illness alert. Know who has seen it.

items.title: Every photo, in place
items.body: Each child gets a dedicated gallery. Photos stay organised, never buried in a shared feed.

items.title: Evenings back for teachers
items.body: Parents see when they are messaging outside nursery hours, before they hit send.

items.title: Arabic from day one
items.body: Full right to left, Arabic notifications and support. Each person picks their own language.

items.title: Nursery pays, not parents
items.body: One flat monthly fee, with no commission on tuition and no charges to parents.
